en: Dependent on an internal wholesome state, a non-internal and unwholesome state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on an external wholesome state, a non-internal and unwholesome state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on both an internal wholesome state and an external wholesome state, a non-internal and unwholesome state [arises].
[It] arises by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*). Under the root [condition], there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance (*avigata*), there are three.
Dependent on an internal unwholesome state, a non-internal and non-unwholesome state arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on an external unwholesome state, a non-internal and non-unwholesome state arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on internal unwholesome states and external unwholesome states, a state that is neither internal nor unwholesome arises by way of the root condition (*hetu-paccaya*).
There are three [instances] under the root condition... pe ... three under the non-disappearance condition. (The indeterminate root has exactly three conditions.)
